title: How Marc Lou gets 300 daily Google visitors for free with programmatic SEO
summary: Marc Lou explains programmatic SEO: pick one low-difficulty keyword, build a few HTML skeletons filled with collected data to create hundreds of long-tail pages, then get about 10 backlinks and wait 3 to 6 months. He says he built his sites once and never touched them again.

principles.text: Programmatic SEO lets a solo developer get free Google traffic without an audience or marketing budget.
principles.quote: You don't need an audience or a marketing budget to get visitors. Here's how to grow a startup for free when you're a solopreneur who loves coding.

principles.text: Start with one main keyword: low difficulty (KD under 20) and 500+ monthly searches in one country.
principles.quote: Keyword Difficulty (KD) lower than 20. It requires 10 backlinks or less required to rank on Google

principles.text: Find at least 20 long-tail variations of the main keyword and build one page per long-tail keyword.
principles.quote: Second, we need numerous long-tail keywords (at least 20).

principles.text: Use a few HTML skeletons plus data to produce many pages; design each skeleton around what the searcher wants to see.
principles.quote: A skeleton is an HTML mold. Add some data, and you have a unique webpage.

principles.text: Rich data makes pages valuable: use APIs, outsource collection to a VA for a few hundred dollars, and use ChatGPT for parts.
principles.quote: To get richer data, outsource the data collection for a few hundred dollars and/or use ChatGPT for some parts, like the meta description.

principles.text: Get about 10 backlinks by launching (Product Hunt gives a follow link), buying directory listings, and requesting indexing; rankings take 3 to 6 months.
principles.quote: Indexing is fast, but ranking for keywords takes 3 to 6 months.
